projectSettings.unitTagsHint: Tags you can put on units, e.g. corner, pool view.

qualification.intro: The system checks each lead's budget and timeline against this project and suggests the next step. Salespeople confirm; disqualifying is never automatic.
qualification.toleranceHint: A budget this far outside the available price range still fits.
qualification.monthsHint: Later than this is "too early" — suggested for Nurture.
qualification.autoHint: When on, a lead that fits and has unit types and intent becomes Qualified by itself.

unitImport.title: Import units from CSV
unitImport.description: In Excel or Google Sheets use File → Save as / Download → CSV. Put several tags in one cell separated by commas. Existing units are skipped; change prices on the Units page.
